parsed.change_summary: Added a width specifier to the printf format string for int_type->name to limit the number of characters printed to the size of the buffer.
parsed.how_trigger_is_blocked: The trigger described in the finding no longer works because the printf format string now includes a width specifier that limits the number of characters printed to the size of the buffer. This prevents a buffer overflow from occurring if int_type->name is too long.
